Get ready to meet Esther - the thirty-something woman who will do absolutely anything to get her man...

*A WHS TRAVEL BOOKCLUB PICK*
*AN INSTANT NO.1 BESTSELLER*

'This is such a great book. People will LOVE it!’ MARIAN KEYES

'I loved this book. A wild ride of a read, funny yet poignant, it is a gripping page turner.' LIZ NUGENT

'Looks set to be the smash hit of 2026.' IRISH TIMES

'Easily the funniest book I’ve read this year, I adored it.' ANDREA MARA

'I adored this book so much I read it in a day.' SARAH PINBOROUGH

You're the love of Esther's life. You just don't know it yet...

Esther first sees Ted walking in a park in London. They lock eyes - and for a fraction of a second, she feels something she’s never felt before.

When she learns that Ted is an actor, she starts reading up about his life in Canada. She watches all the interviews with him that she can find online. She even joins the 'Tedettes', a Facebook group of obsessive fans who stalk Ted's every move.

Soon Esther decides to take things more seriously. She leaves her husband, takes all their savings, and buys a one-way ticket to Canada.

After all, Ted might not know it yet, but they are meant to be together – he just needs a little bit of persuading...

***Readers love Esther is Now Following You!***
